data.name: Tyrell
data.gender_notes: Tyrell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘tyrrel’, meaning ‘tireless’ or ‘strong hill’. Used in Middle English as a surname, and later adopted as a given name in the English-speaking world. In Christian tradition, Tyrell is a name for those who embody strength and perseverance. The name Tyrell carries the meaning “Tireless, strong hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tyrell usually hope their child will grow to embody tireless, strong hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tyrell is a name that resonates with the earth and the natural world. It suggests a strong and grounded personality, with a deep connection to the land and a practical, down-to-earth approach to life.
data.etymology: Tyrell belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tireless, strong hill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tyrell total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
